title: fix(plugin-grid,app-shell): the import wizard offers only the write modes the identity import accepts (objectui#12697)
body:
Fixes #12697
Clause-②: yes

One optional host prop, `writeModes`, is added to the exported `ImportWizardProps` of `@object-ui/plugin-grid`. Nothing narrows: a host that leaves the prop out still gets all three modes.

## What changed

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/identityImport.ts`: `IDENTITY_IMPORT_WRITE_MODES = ['insert', 'upsert']` states the identity door's accepted modes once, beside `resolveIdentityWriteOptions`. The refusal now refuses every mode outside that constant, with the same message as before.
- `packages/plugin-grid/src/ImportWizard.tsx`: new optional prop `writeModes`, which defaults to all three modes. The write-mode select lists only those modes. The start and reset mode is `insert` when it is offered, otherwise the first offered mode. A saved mapping whose mode is not offered is listed disabled, with its mode named after its label, and is never applied or swapped to another mode. An empty `writeModes` throws. The write-mode labels come from one literal-key helper, `writeModeLabel`, so the language-pack key census sees all three.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx`: on the identity import branch only (the existing `identityImportEnabled` predicate), the view passes `writeModes: IDENTITY_IMPORT_WRITE_MODES`. Every other object keeps all three modes. No list of identity objects is added.

## The door read

objectstack serves no datum that names the accepted modes. `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/import-users` validates `mode` inline (objectstack `fd0e72a`, `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-import-users.ts`, lines 508 to 509, which answer `mode must be "insert" or "upsert"`). The local constant beside the refusal is therefore the door read, and its docblock cites that check.

## Evidence

- New tests: `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/importWriteModes-12697.test.tsx` (6 tests) and `packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/identityImportWriteModes-12697.test.tsx` (4 tests). The second file pins that the refusal and the offer read the same constant, and that ObjectView passes that constant itself.
- Ablations at `5806d15` (the label helper since then changes no tested behaviour), each restored to its HEAD blob:
  - select hard-coded to three modes: 2 red;
  - host drops the prop: 1 red;
  - refusal hard-coded while the constant drifts: 2 red, against a control where the constant drifts alone and only 1 is red;
  - saved-mapping item no longer disabled: 1 red.
- Affected families at `5806d15`: 115 files, 1617 passed, 13 skipped. Both packages type-check, and the closure build is green.
- i18n rework at `8ebd217`: `check:i18n-keys` exit 0 (exit 1 at `5806d15`, `ImportWizard.tsx:1404:34 [undeclared-dynamic-family]`); `check:i18n-drift` and `check:i18n-dead-keys` exit 0; `plugin-grid` type-check plus 87 files including `packages/i18n/src/__tests__`: 1341 passed, 13 skipped.
- Live reading on the published `@objectstack/*@18.0.0-next.2` showcase:
  - before, `sys_user` offers "Always create new", "Update existing (skip if no match)" and "Update if matched, else create";
  - after, it offers "Always create new" and "Update if matched, else create";
  - `showcase_account` still offers all three.
  - The screenshots are in `evidence/12697/` on branch `claude/issue-12697-evidence` (`63a08db`).

## Acceptance notes

- Picking a saved mapping in `insert` mode, or with no mode, after manually choosing `upsert` keeps `upsert`, because only update and upsert mappings set the mode. This was read from the code and not reproduced. It is not changed here.
- The dispatch's premise about an `import-wizard` schema node is moot: that node key is already retired.
